body.name: stationary-overlap-preserving scaled signed-depth alternatives
body.construction:
For \(C>1\), \(Q\ge1\), and \(v\in\{-1,+1\}\), take \(X_t\) constant, \(H_t=(J_t,U_t)\in\{0,\ldots,Q\}\times\{-1,+1\}\), \(b(1)=1/L\), and \(e(1)=1\).  Draw a reset sign from \(\Pr(U=u)=(1+u\varepsilon_C)/2\).  If \(J_t=Q\), set \(J_{t+1}=0\) and draw a reset sign.  If \(J_t<Q\), reset in the same way with probability \(1-\alpha\); otherwise set \(J_{t+1}=J_t+1\), retaining \(U_t\) when \(A_t=1\) and replacing it by an independent fair sign when \(A_t=0\).  Independently of the next-state draw conditional on \((J_t,U_t,A_t)\), draw \(Y_t\in\{-M_1,+M_1\}\) with
\[
 \Pr_v(Y_t=y\mid J_t,U_t,A_t)
 =\{1+(y/M_1)v\gamma_0U_t\mathbf 1(J_t=Q)\}/2.
\]
Initialize from the behavior-stationary law \(d_b(j,u)=w_j(1+u\varepsilon_CL^{-j})/2\).
